properties.description: Genie-style surgical video world model with a latent action model learned without action labels, evaluated by generation quality and controllability on SurgToolLoc-2022.

VQ-VAE video tokenizer, a latent action model producing discrete action codes from frame pairs, and a MaskGIT-style spatio-temporal dynamics transformer that generates future frame tokens from prompt frames and actions.

capability_assessments.rationale: Generated future frames are scored against ground truth with PSNR, SSIM and FVD, which meets L1. L2 is not claimed because the actions are unlabeled latent codes inferred from the ground-truth target frame or sampled at random, are not mapped to physical tool motion, and controllability is shown only as a fidelity difference between the two conditions. Core membership holds because frame token history is carried through learned temporal dynamics.

legacy_cells.S: Can prompt surgical frames and latent action embeddings generate future action-controllable surgical video frames?
legacy_cells.T: Video clips of surgical trainees performing training exercises including tissue dissection and suturing; no patient cohort is reported.
legacy_cells.U: Medical professionals for training and developers/trainers of autonomous surgical agents (proposed potential users).
legacy_cells.AI: Endoscopic surgical video/image frames; learned latent action embeddings
legacy_cells.AJ: Spatio-temporal Transformer encoders/decoder and causal Transformer dynamics model
legacy_cells.BD: Latent action embeddings inferred from adjacent frames or sampled from a learned codebook; executable action attributes are not specified.
legacy_cells.BL: 16-frame clips sampled at 1 frame per second; generated frames are evaluated at 1 fps.
legacy_cells.BP: 16-frame training clips sampled at 1 fps; results also use one- or four-frame prompts.
legacy_cells.BS: Future surgical video frames generated by predicting video tokens and decoding them into frames.
legacy_cells.BV: VQ-VAE reconstruction and commitment losses for the tokenizer and latent-action model; MaskGIT masked-token prediction for dynamics.
legacy_cells.EB: Generation differs under changed latent actions; ground-truth-inferred actions yield positive ΔPSNR versus random actions.
legacy_cells.FB: State abstraction is discrete video-token codes produced by a VQ-VAE tokenizer.
legacy_cells.FL: Video frames → VQ-VAE spatio-temporal Transformer tokenizer/discrete tokens; latent-action Transformer infers embeddings from adjacent frames; causal spatio-temporal Transformer predicts future tokens conditioned on prior tokens and actions; tokenizer decoder renders frames; no planner/readout head.
legacy_cells.FM: Authors introduce SurgWM, an action-controllable surgical visual world model that learns latent actions from unlabelled surgical video and generates action-conditioned surgical data.
legacy_cells.FN: Authors report action-dependent generations, positive ΔPSNR for ground-truth-inferred versus random actions, and better SSIM/FVD for ground-truth-inferred actions; no reliably aligned numeric table values transcribed.
legacy_cells.FP: Authors propose future work on training an RL agent in generated environments, disentangling latent actions, improving tool-shape consistency, and using small action-annotated datasets.
legacy_cells.FQ: Authors identify a gap in realistic surgical world models trained on real surgical video without ground-truth action annotation; prior approaches often use simplified simulations or labeled actions.
legacy_cells.FR: Evidence supports action-conditioned visual generation/controllability on one surgical-video dataset, not executable action grounding, validated tissue mechanics, causal treatment effects, clinical benefit, or closed-loop policy performance.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M4 Action service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M6 Rollout service; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Pass the paper’s specified action and time context explicitly into the state-transition interface; preserve the boundary between predictive action sensitivity and identified intervention effects.
legacy_cells.FX: Title/abstract p. 1; Introduction pp. 1–2; Methods pp. 3–4; Implementation details/data and Table 1 p. 5; Results and Table 2 pp. 6–8; Conclusion p. 9; References pp. 9–10. No standalone limitations section. The extracted Table 2 text has ambiguous row/column alignment, so uncertain numerical values were not transcribed. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: A:I left untouched; the PDF did not directly contradict the prefilled workbook metadata. No numeric Table 2 cells were entered because the extracted table alignment is ambiguous. No prospective, external, clinical-outcome, causal-identification, executable-action, or closed-loop policy evidence is demonstrated. Evidence QA: 36/62 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (58.1%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Omitted/unsupported extraction entries: DZE3=FVD10 and SSIM are reported; the paper states both are better for ground-truth-inferred actions than random actions. Codex audit: 55 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 7 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: All 10 pages were read as extracted text (page 10 contains References 13 to 25). Page 3 (Figure 1) and page 8 (Table 2) were visually inspected; pages 6 and 7 (Figures 2 and 3) were rendered in the earlier review pass and Table 1 (hyperparameters, p. 5) was verified from text.
The legacy row was read from the root workbook (read only). Saved API drafts for A09 were not opened.
Schema validity and quote occurrence do not establish semantic correctness. One reviewer pass, no independent human review.
notes: SurgWM adapts the Genie recipe to surgical video: a VQ-VAE tokenizer, a latent action model with 12 discrete codes learned from frame pairs, and a MaskGIT-style spatio-temporal dynamics model. On SurgToolLoc-2022 training exercise clips it reports PSNR 17.67 to 16.49 (one prompt frame, ground-truth-inferred actions) against 15.86 to 14.73 with random actions, delta PSNR about 2 dB, and FVD10 of 1717.59 against 2079.46. Classified L1, core, R2 (offline). Source points: no split or baseline, oracle action inference from the target frame, latent actions not grounded.
